header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البيهقي في شعب الايمان مشكوة المصابيح رقم: ٥٠٢٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Shall I tell you the fundamental matter of the Deen through which you will attain the good of both worlds? Sit in the gatherings of those who do the Dhikr of Allah. And when you are alone, keep moving your tongue with the Dhikr of Allah as much as you can.” Hazrat Abu Razin (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاس ﵄ قَالَ: قِيلَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! أَيُّ جُلَسَائِنَا خَيْرٌ؟ قَالَ: مَنْ ذَكَّرَكُمُ اللهَ رُؤْيَتُهُ وَزَادَ فِي عَمَلِكُمْ مَنْطِقُهُ وَذَكَّرَكُمْ بِاْلآخِرَةِ عَمَلُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابويعلي وفيه مبارك بن حسان وقد وثق وبقية رجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد:٣٨٩/١٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ was asked, “With whom is it best for us to sit?” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Sit with the one whose sight reminds you of Allah, whose speech brings progress in your deeds, and whose deeds make you think of the Hereafter.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ ذَكَرَ اللهَ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللهِ حَتَّي يُصِيبَ اْلاَرْضَ مِنْ دُمُوعِهِ لَمْ يُعَذِّبْهُ اللهُ تَعَالَي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقَالَ: هذا حديث صحيح الاسنادولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٢٦٠/٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever does the Dhikr of Allah and then sheds tears out of the fear of Allah until the tears fall on the ground, Allah will not punish him on the Day of Qiyamah.” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.
